about.title: Simi Valley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Simi Valley is home to roughly 126,788 people, and most days pass without incident along SR-118, Los Angeles Avenue, Cochran Street and Royal Avenue. Public records for 2025, the most recent final year, still show 357 injury collisions, 500 people hurt and 5 traffic deaths within the city. Each of those five numbers was a person with a household, a routine and people who counted on them. Not every fatal loss here happens on the road, either. A fall at a job site, a medication error, neglect in a care facility, or a defective product can end a life just as suddenly. California law gives certain survivors a way to seek accountability through a civil wrongful death action, which runs on its own track apart from any criminal case in Ventura County. LawProactive exists to take one burden off your shoulders. Tell us what happened, and we will connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters, works on contingency, and understands what Simi Valley families are facing.

whyChoose.title: How LawProactive Helps Simi Valley Families

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who belongs in the claim before anyone files.

items.title: Deadlines tracked from the start
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency is involved. Early contact keeps those dates from slipping.

items.title: The full picture of your loss
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Your attorney documents all of it, on contingency, with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My relative died in a crash on SR-118 near Simi Valley. Does a criminal case stop us from filing?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that proceeds separately from anything the Ventura County District Attorney does. The two cases can move at the same time, and the outcome of one does not decide the other. An attorney can explain how evidence from the crash investigation may still be useful to your family.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring the claim?
items.answer: California puts a surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children at the front of the line. If there are none, the right passes to certain dependents and heirs under the state's rules. Because families are rarely simple, it helps to have an attorney confirm everyone's position before filing.

items.question: How long do we have, and what does it cost to get started?
items.answer: The general deadline is two years from the date of death, but it shrinks considerably if a government entity such as a city or Caltrans may share responsibility. Reaching out to LawProactive is free, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.
